svg.aria-label: JTM45 · TURRET BOARD LAYOUT (DERIVED) — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Marshall JTM45 factory schematic ('Basic schematic for Marshall trem amps, types 1961, 1962, 1987/T') — layout derived from this schematic; no factory layout sheet located — not a trace

Heater layer: no factory board-layout drawing exists for this amplifier, so its heater wiring cannot be read off one. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V3, V4) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply
straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. The valves on the chain are this circuit's own; the order the chain reaches them in is this drawing's convention.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
